title: Scrollable PDFs and livelier blooms
message: PDF pages now respond reliably to vertical swipes, and Our Blooms has a brighter, more animated shared garden.
changes: PDF pages now scroll reliably with vertical swipes on Android

Garden motion respects the device accessibility setting
